entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: I really messed that up. I can't believe[n]I mixed up the gas and brake pedals...

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Eh, oh well.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: First, I need to fix this up...

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: That oughta do it.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Okay!

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: So, did you need something from me?

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Were you drawn here by the smell too?

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Huh? Mister... have we met before?

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Oh, never mind then. I guess I was[n]mistaken.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Were you drawn here by the smell too?

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Oh, sorry—I guess you just got here too,[n]huh?

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: I can definitely understand not knowing[n]what's going on here—don't worry.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Hmmm, I think I'm starting to get it,[n]though...

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: ...So THAT'S what this place is!

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: This is a place created by the cognitions[n]of people like yourself...

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Your memories and feelings are[n]collected here and given shape.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Boy, am I sure glad I came here now![n]I bet this place can teach me all sorts[n]of things.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: I'm going to stick around here for[n]a while. You could take a look[n]around too, if that interests you.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: I'm curious to see more of the[n]memories inside you.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: If there's anything you don't understand,[n]just ask me! I'll help as much as I can.

entries.speaker: [f 7 1]
entries.en: Well, that should wrap it up. Good job.
